### Tips from Jennifer Moore - June 30, 2026

- **Focus on Form and Technique:** When incorporating progressive overload into your training, maintaining proper form is crucial. Ensure you’re controlling the weight and moving in the right manner to prevent injury.
- **Progressive Overload:** Introduce small increases in weight or resistance over time to challenge your muscles adaptively. Never rush the process – your body needs time to adjust and strengthen.
- **Rest and Nutrition:** Prioritize getting enough rest and choosing the right foods. Hydration is also key to support your fitness journey.
